title: Battle of Paphos
text: The Battle of Paphos, also known as the Battle of Karacehennem, was a naval engagement fought in the summer of 1609 off the coast of Cyprus, near Paphos. The battle took place between the Ottoman Navy, commanded by Kapudan-ı Derya Halil Pasha, and a squadron of heavily armed Christian corsair galleons. The engagement resulted in a decisive Ottoman victory, highlighted by the capture of an enormous 90-gun galleon known to the Ottomans as Karacehennem with around 500 men and 200 rifles.
